newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK examiner admits passing exam questions to son.
newsitem.headline: HK examiner admits passing exam questions to son.

text.p: A Hong Kong examination officer pleaded guilty on Wednesday to passing photocopies of exam papers and exam marking schemes to his son.

The territory's Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC), usually busy tackling multi-million dollar frauds and bribery scandals, was called in to investigate the leak after a student obtained unusually high marks for this summer's exams.
In court, Mak Cheung-wah, 42, admitted to having given his son copies of exam questions and the marking schemes of eight subjects and told him to learn them by heart.
But in mitigation, Mak's lawyer said the defendant had committed the crime out of love for his son.
An ICAC spokesperson said Mak would be sentenced on August 28. Mak was freed on bail of HK$5,000 (US$646).
